content:
maria: Hey PDX travelers — landing tomorrow AM for a conference near the Pearl. Any must-try breakfast or coffee spots within a 10-min walk of the Ace Hotel?
vivian: Stumptown Coffee for a classic. If you want pastries, Coquine is excellent but slightly farther.
sam: For something super Portland-y try Mother's Bistro for brunch, tiny lines if you go early (~8am).
james: If you want specialty toast/sandwiches, check out Biscuit Bitch (fun, messy).
maria: Nice — looking for something that’s open early-ish and has decent seating for quick catch-up with the team.
vivian: In that case, Tf6d Coffee opens at 7, small but quiet. Also Pulaski Park Cafe for outdoor seating.
sam: Another solid choice: Blue Star Donuts (not sit-down, but great walk-and-eat).
maria: Any recs for vegan options nearby? A few folks are plant-based.
james: Petite Sweets? Actually Gospel PDX has a killer vegan breakfast sandwich. Nearby and quick.
vivian: Also Blossoms Bakery (vegan pastries) — they close midday though.
maria: Awesome — vote time: who’s up for sit-down breakfast at Mother's vs quick coffee at Stumptown vs vegan at Gospel?
lunch-bot: Poll created: "PDX breakfast plan" — 1) Mother's Bistro (sit-down) 2) Stumptown quick coffee 3) Gospel PDX (vegan). React with :one:, :two:, or :three:.
sam: :two: — need caffeine first thing.
james: :three: — I’m bringing a plant-based teammate.
vivian: :one: — want a proper breakfast.
maria: Looks mixed. I’ll aim to meet at Stumptown at 7:30 and pivot based on who shows. Ping me if you’re late: hotel lobby is loud.
sam: Sounds good — ping @maria if running late.
james: Thanks for the recs, everyone. If anyone wants maps, I’ll drop a quick pin.
maria: Please do — and if anyone else has a hidden gem, drop it here. Thanks!
